content: Insurance agent Anita Sharma sent an email to customer Saanvi Pillai detailing the Critical Illness Rider for her existing Life Policy (LC-2024-78901). The email outlines the rider features including coverage for 15 illnesses, a sum insured of ₹5,00,000, an additional annual premium of ₹7,200, a 90-day waiting period, and instructions to proceed by replying 'Accept Rider'. It also confirms Mr. Arjun Pillai as the current beneficiary.

action_items: Review the attached Rider Summary PDF
Reply with 'Accept Rider' and confirm desired sum insured if wishing to proceed
Confirm if any changes are required to the current beneficiary
